tools.description: Read public school information, request policy and lesson catalogue links.

tools.name: list_lesson_options
tools.description: Read active online lesson services and prices from the school catalogue.

tools.name: search_lesson_availability
tools.description: Read public requestable slots. No learner names or private schedule IDs are returned.

tools.name: create_lesson_request
tools.description:
Send voluntarily supplied contacts to Voice School/coach (Telegram notification).

    Obtain explicit user consent first. This creates a lead, never a confirmed lesson.
    Reuse idempotency_key after a timeout; do not retry uncertain outcomes with new keys.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "voice_school_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Public description, policy, and catalog links for Voice School online vocal lesson requests." → after: "Read public school information, request policy and lesson catalogue links."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
